关闭开关时，明细字段会隐藏，其值仍保留，且不参与必填校验，因此仍可生成检查草稿。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="旅行同行人条件")
toggle = Switch(label="需要同行人明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="同行人姓名", bind=$name, required=true)
detailField = TextField(label="同行人明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此旅行同行人条件表单，核对姓名与明细条件，并指出需要补充或确认的内容。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
